svg.aria-label: Convert an LLC to a C-Corp
svg.title: Convert an LLC to a C-Corp
svg.desc: The LLC is about to raise or grant options, so it becomes a Delaware C-Corp: assess the timing and tax consequences, get counsel's sign-off, have the members approve a plan of conversion, file the Certificate of Conversion together with the Certificate of Incorporation, then re-issue equity and refile 83(b) elections under the new corporation.
